headline: EPS declines year-over-year despite sequential rebound
summary_short: Daiichi Sankyo reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥37.72, down 18.1% y/y from ¥46.03.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥37.72 fell 18.1% year-over-year from ¥46.03, though it rebounded 63.3% sequentially from ¥23.10 in the prior quarter. Diluted EPS was ¥37.70, down a similar ~18% y/y from ¥46.01 (no diluted q/q comparison available). This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
